# Site check: mychata.cz after the T-040 / migration 0030 publish, 18 Oct 2026

Run about 12:25–12:35 Czech time from a cloud session by the site-check subagent. Read-only: no sign-in, no clicks that change data, no forms sent, only made-up tokens opened. The Chrome DevTools MCP was not available. `bun run e2e` could not run (see below), so the subagent repeated every assertion of `tests/e2e/public.spec.ts` in its own headless Chromium scripts (390×812 and 375×812) and used curl for the raw HTML.

**Live commit: `7ab6f5e`** (`<meta name="build-sha" content="7ab6f5efb39128714b5c6f2f932d0041f77e6200">`, `build-time` `2026-10-18T10:18:38.482Z`). That is Lovable's "Applied migration 0030" commit of 10:18 UTC, merged to `main` as PR #59 (`8dfdfb5`, 10:22 UTC); its files are identical to `main` at `8dfdfb5`. It contains PR #58 (T-040). **T-040 and migration 0030 are live.**

## e2e

`E2E_BASE_URL=https://mychata.cz PW_CHROMIUM_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium bun run e2e` failed before any test ran, because this fresh container has no `node_modules`:

```
$ playwright test
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package '@playwright/test' imported from /home/user/mychata/playwright.config.ts
    at Object.getPackageJSONURL (node:internal/modules/package_json_reader:314:9)
    ... (node ESM resolver frames)
  code: 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND'
}
error: script "e2e" exited with code 1
```

Installing dependencies needs the registry-URL rewrite from `docs/architecture/environments.md`; the session's permission check blocked that, and it was not worked around. The six assertions of `tests/e2e/public.spec.ts` were repeated with the preinstalled Playwright and `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`; all held. These are equivalent checks, not the official run.

## Seen, not changed

- The cookie banner, once shown, covers the sign-in buttons until a choice is made (F-03, deferred).
- The 800 px autumn photo is 181 KB and is the LCP element; LCP on `/` was 2.5 s in this run.

## Not verified

- The official `bun run e2e` run (no `node_modules`, install blocked).
- A real EU visitor's cookie banner (simulated CZ answer only).
- A DevTools performance trace and INP (no DevTools MCP; INP needs a click, which was not allowed).
- Anything signed in, including the T-040 fixes and migration 0030 themselves; this check covers only the public pages.
